validation.input: Real owned stock C3 level and door COG bytes; fixture world with six stock door bindings and representative opening coordinates
validation.path_search: Actual Bot_AddEdge and Bot_SearchPaths on a four-node walking graph; expected parent was alternate without the key, direct with the key, direct while fully open, and alternate after closure.
validation.controls: Single gates require exactly one correct key. Paired interior gates accept a nonzero correct key. Exterior unkeyed path remains available. Wrong script digest, other level and non-CTF disable the candidate. A moving door takes the closed-door rule.
validation.scope: Ordinary first-anchor approaches and registered walking edges. Friendly airlock control, airborne routes and match performance await private gameplay trials.
